title: 原自然probe PG测试仅owned scratch隔离
summary: Hardened probe live PostgreSQL test fixture to require explicit owned loopback test DB opt-in and eliminate hardcoded connection to shared dev instance (port 15432) or fixed schemas: 1) _validate_owned_loopback_pg_dsn strictly enforces loopback host (127.0.0.1/localhost/::1), postgresql scheme, rejection of query parameter injection, rejection of unowned shared dev port 15432 without explicit PROBE_TEST_POSTGRES_OWNED opt-in, and zero DSN/credential leakage in error messages; 2) test_asyncpg_case_source_live_postgres_queries requires explicit test DSN opt-in via PROBE_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN / PANTHEON_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN, safely skipping when unconfigured instead of connecting to shared default instances; 3) Every test run generates randomized, unique scratch schemas (probe_bff_scratch_<hex>, probe_reg_scratch_<hex>, probe_src_scratch_<hex>) and strictly cleans up only its own created schemas in finally block, completely eliminating fixed schemas (test_bff_live, test_reg_live, test_src_live); 4) Real Source and Registry existing DTO contracts and adversarial checks (wrong-tenant, unobserved source, malformed/non-mapping metadata, future candidates) are fully maintained and verified; 5) Validated with a dedicated owned disposable PostgreSQL container: zero skips across all 105 tests, clean schema drops (0 lingering schemas verified), and container destroyed.

counterexamples_eliminated.hardcoded_shared_15432: Eliminated hardcoded localhost:15432 connection; test skips safely when no owned DSN is provided
counterexamples_eliminated.fixed_schemas_collision: Eliminated fixed schema names test_bff_live/test_reg_live/test_src_live; uses randomized unique scratch schemas
counterexamples_eliminated.non_loopback_dsn_leakage: Rejected remote/external and non-loopback DSN fail-closed without leaking DSN or credentials in error messages
counterexamples_eliminated.unowned_port_15432_use: Rejects default shared compose container on port 15432 unless explicitly declared owned disposable
counterexamples_eliminated.shared_schema_mutation: Only creates and cleans up its own scratch schemas, ensuring no mutation or deletion of shared schemas

verification.output: 104 passed, 1 skipped in 37.69s (live query fixture safely skipped without opt-in)
